iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PROFILE::oneconnect
       Returns the value of a Oneconnect profile setting.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::oneconnect ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned Oneconnect profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in the assigned Oneconnect profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the command.
